Question.
Let D4D_{4} be the reflection arrangement. What is the smallest degree in which the (filtered) Varchenko–Gelfand ideal of this arrangement can be generated? (That is, what is the smallest degree dd such that the Varchenko–Gelfand ideal can be generated with relations of degree dd or less.)

Solution.
The twelve hyperplanes of the D4D_{4} arrangement are given by the following equations
This arrangement has 124124 circuits, defining 124124 generators of the Varchenko–Gelfand ideal. The 124124 circuits are

This already tells us that 2≤d≤42\leq d\leq 4, so we just need to check the smallest degree of generation. Let us start with an easy check for d=2d=2: there are 1616 relations that have size three or less. We can construct a “truncated” Varchenko–Gelfand ideal using only the circuits of size three or less. If this generates the whole ideal, then we will be done.
